page.overview:
Who is Fu Karaq?

Born as a member of the influential Fu family that was strongly involved in Jasmine Island's tea production, Karaq was raised to be a master tea maker and eagerly embraced this career path. However, he did not see tea making as an art form as most did, but as a science. Thus, he spent years on the research of tea in a laboratory. Karaq eventually separated all kinds of tea based on the "five divine attributes", and concluded that he could create the perfect tea mélange if he discovered the correct mixture of the "five divine attributes". Concerned over his scientific obsessions, Karaq's close family urged him to join the Jasmine Island protectors to "expand his horizons".

Fu Karaq thus took part in a formal tea ceremony in an temple at Jasmine Island's coast, where he and four others —Ara, Joh, Revik, Yarru— had gathered with the protectors' leader Chidaw and an elderly talekeeper named Siarruk. In this ceremony, they officially joined the protectors. Later that day, the five new protectors opted to celebrate their new status together, and took a small fishing boat on a joyride. Eventually, they spotted a large warship approaching Jasmine Island, followed by a smaller vessel. To the group's shock, the large ship was manned by Fifth Nation corsairs under Tagaka, while the smaller ship was attacking them under the leadership of famous Fire National Hei-Ran. After making contact with the latter, Karaq and his comrades hurried back to Jasmine Island to warn the locals of the upcoming pirate raid.

The group and the other protectors subsequently fended off a first landing led by a pirate scout force under Erchtei. Indeed, Karaq and his comrades fought hard in the subsequent battle, even battling Tagaka herself and helping to defeat Erchtei, though both managed to escape. The group also discovered that another protector, Mirlon, had defected to the Fifth Nation and assisted the raid. They confronted the turncoat.

Karaq and his comrades subsequently helped to decide what the Jasmine Islanders should do with the pirates captured during the failed raid. They also tried to mediate in an unexpected dispute between Hei-Ran and the rescued Tei Eesoni.
